帮我生成一个日线双均线趋势跟踪策略，20日均线上穿60日均线买入，下穿卖出，不要杠杆。
raw_output:
def generate_signals(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    ma20 = df['close'].rolling(20).mean()
    ma60 = df['close'].rolling(60).mean()
    signals = pd.Series(0, index=df.index)
    valid = ma20.notna() & ma60.notna()
    signals[valid] = (ma20[valid] > ma60[valid]).astype(int)
    return signals

def generate_signals(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    ema_fast = df['close'].ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()
    ema_slow = df['close'].ewm(span=26, adjust=False).mean()
    macd_line = ema_fast - ema_slow
    signal_line = macd_line.ewm(span=9, adjust=False).mean()
    
    cross_up = (macd_line > signal_line) & (macd_line.shift(1) <= signal_line.shift(1))
    cross_down = (macd_line < signal_line) & (macd_line.shift(1) >= signal_line.shift(1))
    
    signals = pd.Series(0, index=df.index)
    signals[cross_up] = 1
    signals[cross_down] = 0
    return signals.ffill().fillna(0).astype(int)

def generate_signals(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    ema12 = df['close'].ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()
    ema26 = df['close'].ewm(span=26, adjust=False).mean()
    diff = ema12 - ema26
    buy = (diff > 0) & (diff.shift(1) <= 0)
    sell = (diff < 0) & (diff.shift(1) >= 0)
    signals = pd.Series(0, index=df.index)
    signals[buy] = 1
    signals[sell] = 0
    return signals.ffill().fillna(0)

我想要低频一点的趋势跟踪，每周检查一次，20周均线向上突破60周均线再买。
raw_output:
def generate_signals(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    tmp = df.copy()
    tmp['date'] = pd.to_datetime(tmp['date'])
    tmp['yw'] = tmp['date'].dt.year.astype(str) + '_' + tmp['date'].dt.isocalendar().week.astype(str)
    weekly_close = tmp.groupby('yw')['close'].last()
    ma20 = weekly_close.rolling(20).mean()
    ma60 = weekly_close.rolling(60).mean()
    sig_w = (ma20 > ma60).astype(int)
    tmp['signal'] = tmp['yw'].map(sig_w).fillna(0).astype(int)
    return tmp['signal']
